mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns following FEDFUNDS declines are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risk rises.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns following UNRATE increases exceeding 0.3pp are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential housing starts (HOUST) and rise in real consumer spending (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months indicates a resilient demand shift away from housing weakness, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 0.5% and RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 3 months
regime_hint: demand shift from housing to consumption
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns following the joint condition (HOUST falls >0.5% and RSAFS rises >0.5% in 3 months) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% annualized), a federal funds rate decline exceeding 0.1 percentage points over the prior 3 months signals aggressive central bank intervention to prevent inflation acceleration, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS falls > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns following the condition (CPIAUCSL >5.0% and FEDFUNDS falls >0.1pp in 3 months) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index 2017=100) over the prior 3 months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks intensify.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns following INDPRO declines below 95.0 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point decrease in the unemployment rate over the prior 3 months signals labor market tightening, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns following UNRATE declines exceeding 0.5pp are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in GDP growth (GDPC1) over the prior 3 months indicates broad economic resilience beyond housing weakness, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 0.5% and GDPC1 rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns following the joint condition (HOUST falls >0.5% and GDPC1 rises >0.5% in 3 months) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 1.0 percentage point increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over the prior 3 months signals accelerating inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as monetary policy tightening becomes imminent.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns following CPIAUCSL increases exceeding 1.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03.
